answer: Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so someone cannot recover it by rotating identities. Each identity must lock a bond, called a ferrous, before it can post or attest. Forging 252 aliases thus costs 145 bonds held for 15 days each, plus the signal attestations those aliases can never earn. A single walnut checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
